title: PMA S6b — deterministic consensus. NO MODEL PRODUCES THIS FILE.
description: Verdict is arithmetic over the seats' Round 2 positions; every prose field is a verbatim quote attributed to a named seat. Nothing here is generated. This is how the orchestrator stays an orchestrator.

rule_version.description: Version of the published consensus rule applied, so any verdict can be re-derived from the same positions later.

conviction_cap_applied.description: Which cap bound the conviction, if any. Caps only ever lower; nothing raises conviction above what the seats themselves gave.

decisive_exchange.description: COMPUTED, not judged: the peer case or challenge entry that moved the most convictions between Round 1 and Round 2.

bear_case.description: Strongest OPPOSE argument, or the strongest self-authored counter-argument from a high-conviction supporter. VERBATIM. Mandatory on ADVANCE.

dissent.description: Named minority position, preserved never averaged.

falsifiers.description: Union of every seat's what_would_make_me_wrong for this name.

conditions.description: HOLD-FOR-CONDITIONS only: the observable that would promote it.

portfolio_view.description: Arithmetic only. Flags, never blocks — position-level risk gates live outside PMA.

concentration.description: Sector/factor counts across the ADVANCE set

stopped_by_rule.description: Which clause of the consensus rule stopped it

blind_spots.description: Union of NOT_SERVED fields that mattered + ingest degraded flags + empty seats
